scoring.mutant: Require valid nonempty clarification whose question/reason/evidence identifies the intended unresolved choice; no literal-string matching. Independent semantic review judges equivalent wording.
scoring.positive: Require ordinary successful phase completion without marker, protected-source preservation, applicable phase checks, and preserved positiveFidelity. Malformed artifact or deleted runtime questions is not a pass.
scoring.separate: Provider/auth/timeout/mechanical execution failure, unsupported acceptance and inconclusive semantic judgment remain separate from false positives/negatives.
scoring.rerun: Restore only original workflow.md bytes and repeat the identical command in that workspace; separately record a fresh restored-source run. No answers or generated-artifact edits.
